channel.title: Blindspot
channel.description: Independent, rigorous analysis of geopolitics, global economy, security, technology, and power. What mainstream coverage leaves out.

item.title: An armed attack in Krakow exposes the security vulnerabilities of open European public squares
item.description: Five people are dead and at least 10 injured following a shooting near the main market square in Krakow. The incident highlights the persistent difficulty of securing dense urban environments against sudden localized violence.

item.title: Guatemalan Lawmaker Murder Highlights Rising Political Risk Ahead of National Elections
item.description: An armed ambush in eastern Guatemala leaves a member of congress and three officers dead. The attack underscores the lethal overlap between organized crime corridors and national political party realignment.
